title: MatrixZero
summary: Encrypted Matrix chat: rooms, DMs, photos, voice messages, emoji verify
description:
MatrixZero is a full Matrix client for the Cardputer Zero. Sign in to matrix.org or your own homeserver and chat straight from the keyboard.

What it can do:
- Rooms, direct messages and invites, with unread counts, pinning and search
- End-to-end encryption, the same as Element and FluffyChat
- Verify this device from your phone by comparing emoji
- Unlock older encrypted messages with your recovery key
- Reply, edit, delete and react
- Take a photo with the camera and send it, and view images full screen
- Record and send voice messages, and play audio in the chat
- File names on photos, audio and documents
- Emoji in names and messages
- Rooms and messages are saved, so it opens fast

Keys: 4 Menu, 5 React (Pin on the room list), 6 Reply (Find on the room list), 7 Help, 8 Settings. f z x c move around. Fn+H shows every key. Hold Esc to quit.

Your session and keys stay on the device in ~/.local/share/matrixzero.
